name: Freightos Global Booking
description: Compare transparent ocean, air, and trucking quotes from dozens of top-rated international forwarders.
fullDescription: Freightos is the world’s largest online freight marketplace. Like an Expedia for international shipping, it allows e-commerce importers to instantly compare rates, transit times, and customer reviews from dozens of certified logistics providers for ocean containers, air cargo, and customs bonds.
features: Instant comparison of live ocean FCL, LCL, and air cargo quotes
Transparent landed cost breakdown including fuel surcharges and terminal fees
Integrated cargo insurance and single-entry customs bond purchases
24/7 dedicated logistics tracking and automated shipment document storage
Specialized Amazon FBA appointment scheduling and prep services
